tasks.label: teleop: build
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && colcon build --packages-select teleop_bridge && source install/setup.bash

tasks.label: teleop: run steamdeck
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch teleop_bridge steamdeck_bringup.launch.py serial_port:=/dev/ttyUSB0 baudrate:=115200 loop_hz:=100.0

tasks.label: teleop: run robot
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch teleop_bridge robot_bringup.launch.py serial_port:=/dev/ttyUSB0 baudrate:=115200 loop_hz:=100.0

tasks.label: teleop: run video receiver
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch teleop_bridge steamdeck_bringup.launch.py enable_control_link:=false enable_video_stream:=true video_port:=5600 video_sink:=autovideosink

tasks.label: teleop: run video sender
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch teleop_bridge robot_bringup.launch.py enable_control_link:=false enable_video_stream:=true video_target_ip:=192.168.1.10 video_port:=5600

tasks.label: teleop: echo /joy
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /joy

tasks.label: teleop: echo /joy_remote
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /joy_remote

tasks.label: teleop: echo link
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /teleop_link_connected

tasks.label: teleop: echo feedback
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /teleop_feedback
